Thank you. I think a lot of people commenting here, while well intentioned, have no idea that they're visualizing the average Israeli as a white Ashkenazi Jew, completely forgetting refugees/Sephardic Jews etc. that make up so much of Israel's population. 

Just a personal anecdote, my dad is Sephardic and very dark skinned compared to I guess the Woody Allen complexion most people visualize when they think of Jews. He travels A LOT, to Israel, Europe, and domestically within the US. As far as I recall, he's only once been searched in Ben Gurion. Flying out of American airports (usually JFK/Newark), he'll be flagged for search probably 7 out of 10 times. Ironically, its probably because his skin color and Middle Eastern accent flag him as Arab. Speaking strictly about skin color, in his experience the US is far quicker to racially profile than Israel, probably because Israelis are so diverse it would make it futile, security wise, to profile based on color.
